audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Kings / Melakhim Aleph chapter 6, first-pass draft aligned to public-domain verse structure; formal chronological, architectural, and witness audit remains required.
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for exodus chronology, temple measurements, skilled hidden labor, silence symbolism, conditional presence, cedar and gold extraction, cherubim imagery, sacred architecture, and seven-year construction.

verses.restored: In four hundred eightieth year after children of Israel came out from land of Egypt, in fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in month Ziv, second month, he began to build house of YHWH.

familiar.text: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.

modern.text: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, in the month of Ziv, the second month of the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, he began to build the house of the LORD.

original.text: וַיְהִ֣י בִשְׁמוֹנִ֣ים שָׁנָ֣ה וְאַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֣וֹת שָׁנָ֡ה לְצֵ֣את בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מֵאֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַיִם֩ בַּשָּׁנָ֨ה הָרְבִיעִ֜ית בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ זִ֗ו ה֚וּא הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י לִמְלֹ֥ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּ֥בֶן הַבַּ֖יִת לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: House King Solomon built for YHWH was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.

familiar.text: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.

modern.text: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.

original.text: וְהַבַּ֗יִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֜ה הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁשִּֽׁים אַמָּ֥ה אָרְכּ֖וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים רָחְבּ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Porch before temple of house was twenty cubits long across width of house and ten cubits deep before house.

familiar.text: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.

modern.text: The portico at the front of the main hall of the temple was twenty cubits long, extending across the width of the temple and projecting out ten cubits in front of the temple.

original.text: וְהָאוּלָ֗ם עַל פְּנֵי֙ הֵיכַ֣ל הַבַּ֔יִת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ עַל פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֣חַב הַבָּ֑יִת עֶ֧שֶׂר בָּאַמָּ֛ה רָחְבּ֖וֹ עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת

verses.restored: For house he made windows with recessed frames.

familiar.text: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

modern.text: He also had narrow windows framed high in the temple. The Chambers

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לַבָּ֔יִת חַלּוֹנֵ֖י שְׁקֻפִ֥ים אֲטֻמִֽים

verses.restored: Against wall of house he built side chambers around walls of temple and inner sanctuary; he made chambers around.

familiar.text: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:

modern.text: Against the walls of the temple and the inner sanctuary, Solomon built a chambered structure around the temple, in which he constructed the side rooms.

original.text: וַיִּבֶן֩ עַל קִ֨יר הַבַּ֤יִת יצוע סָבִ֔יב אֶת קִיר֤וֹת הַבַּ֨יִת֙ סָבִ֔יב לַֽהֵיכָ֖ל וְלַדְּבִ֑יר וַיַּ֥עַשׂ צְלָע֖וֹת סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: Lowest chamber was five cubits wide, middle six, third seven; outside house he made ledges around so beams would not be inserted into walls of house.

familiar.text: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

modern.text: The bottom floor was five cubits wide, the middle floor six cubits, and the third floor seven cubits. He also placed offset ledges around the outside of the temple, so that nothing would be inserted into its walls.

original.text: היצוע הַתַּחְתֹּנָ֜ה חָמֵ֧שׁ בָּאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבָּ֗הּ וְהַתִּֽיכֹנָה֙ שֵׁ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וְהַ֨שְּׁלִישִׁ֔ית שֶׁ֥בַע בָּאַמָּ֖ה רָחְבָּ֑הּ כִּ֡י מִגְרָעוֹת֩ נָתַ֨ן לַבַּ֤יִת סָבִיב֙ ח֔וּצָה לְבִלְתִּ֖י אֲחֹ֥ז בְּקִֽירוֹת הַבָּֽיִת

verses.restored: When house was built, it was built of stone prepared at quarry; hammer, axe, or any iron tool was not heard in house while it was being built.

familiar.text: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

modern.text: The temple was constructed using finished stones cut at the quarry, so that no hammer or chisel or any other iron tool was heard in the temple while it was being built.

original.text: וְהַבַּ֨יִת֙ בְּהִבָּ֣נֹת֔וֹ אֶֽבֶן שְׁלֵמָ֥ה מַסָּ֖ע נִבְנָ֑ה וּמַקָּב֤וֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן֙ כָּל כְּלִ֣י בַרְזֶ֔ל לֹֽא נִשְׁמַ֥ע בַּבַּ֖יִת בְּהִבָּנֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Entrance for middle side chamber was on right side of house. They went up by winding stairs to middle and from middle to third.

familiar.text: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.

modern.text: The entrance to the bottom floor was on the south side of the temple. A stairway led up to the middle level, and from there to the third floor.

original.text: פֶּ֗תַח הַצֵּלָע֙ הַתִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה אֶל כֶּ֥תֶף הַבַּ֖יִת הַיְמָנִ֑ית וּבְלוּלִּ֗ים יַֽעֲלוּ֙ עַל הַתִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה וּמִן הַתִּֽיכֹנָ֖ה אֶל הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁים

verses.restored: He built house and finished it, roofing house with beams and rows of cedar.

familiar.text: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

modern.text: So Solomon built the temple and finished it, roofing it with beams and planks of cedar.

original.text: וַיִּ֥בֶן אֶת הַבַּ֖יִת וַיְכַלֵּ֑הוּ וַיִּסְפֹּ֤ן אֶת הַבַּ֨יִת֙ גֵּבִ֔ים וּשְׂדֵרֹ֖ת בָּאֲרָזִֽים

verses.restored: He built side chambers against all house, five cubits high, joined to house with cedar timber.

familiar.text: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

modern.text: He built chambers all along the temple, each five cubits high and attached to the temple with beams of cedar. God’s Promise to Solomon

original.text: וַיִּ֤בֶן אֶת היצוע עַל כָּל הַבַּ֔יִת חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֽוֹמָת֑וֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹ֥ז אֶת הַבַּ֖יִת בַּעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִֽים

verses.restored: Word of YHWH came to Solomon, saying:

familiar.text: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,

modern.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying:

original.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Concerning this house you are building: if you walk in my statutes, do my judgments, keep all my commands, and walk in them, I will establish with you my word spoken to David your father.

familiar.text: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:

modern.text: “As for this temple you are building, if you walk in My statutes, carry out My ordinances, and keep all My commandments by walking in them, I will fulfill through you the promise I made to your father David.

original.text: הַבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֜ה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֣ה בֹנֶ֗ה אִם תֵּלֵ֤ךְ בְּחֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֣י תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֥ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתַ֖י לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּהֶ֑ם וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י אֶת דְּבָרִי֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽיךָ

verses.restored: I will dwell among children of Israel and will not abandon my people Israel.

familiar.text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

modern.text: And I will dwell among the Israelites and will not abandon My people Israel.” The Temple’s Interior (2 Chronicles 3:5–9)

original.text: וְשָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֥א אֶעֱזֹ֖ב אֶת עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Solomon built house and finished it.

familiar.text: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

modern.text: So Solomon built the temple and finished it.

original.text: וַיִּ֧בֶן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת הַבַּ֖יִת וַיְכַלֵּֽהוּ

verses.restored: He built walls of house within with cedar boards, from floor of house to walls of ceiling. He covered inside with wood and floor with cypress planks.

familiar.text: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

modern.text: He lined the interior walls with cedar paneling from the floor of the temple to the ceiling, and he covered the floor with cypress boards.

original.text: וַיִּבֶן֩ אֶת קִיר֨וֹת הַבַּ֤יִת מִבַּ֨יְתָה֙ בְּצַלְע֣וֹת אֲרָזִ֔ים מִקַּרְקַ֤ע הַבַּ֨יִת֙ עַד קִיר֣וֹת הַסִּפֻּ֔ן צִפָּ֥ה עֵ֖ץ מִבָּ֑יִת וַיְצַ֛ף אֶת קַרְקַ֥ע הַבַּ֖יִת בְּצַלְע֥וֹת בְּרוֹשִֽׁים

verses.restored: He built twenty cubits at rear of house with cedar boards from floor to walls, making it inner sanctuary, most holy place.

familiar.text: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.

modern.text: He partitioned off the twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.

original.text: וַיִּבֶן֩ אֶת עֶשְׂרִ֨ים אַמָּ֜ה מירכותי הַבַּ֨יִת֙ בְּצַלְע֣וֹת אֲרָזִ֔ים מִן הַקַּרְקַ֖ע עַד הַקִּיר֑וֹת וַיִּ֤בֶן לוֹ֙ מִבַּ֣יִת לִדְבִ֔יר לְקֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים

verses.restored: House—that is, temple before inner sanctuary—was forty cubits.

familiar.text: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.

modern.text: And the main hall in front of this room was forty cubits long.

original.text: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים בָּאַמָּ֖ה הָיָ֣ה הַבָּ֑יִת ה֖וּא הַהֵיכָ֥ל לִפְנָֽי

verses.restored: Cedar within house was carved with gourds and open flowers; all was cedar, and no stone was seen.

familiar.text: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

modern.text: The cedar paneling inside the temple was carved with gourds and open flowers. Everything was cedar; not a stone could be seen.

original.text: וְאֶ֤רֶז אֶל הַבַּ֨יִת֙ פְּנִ֔ימָה מִקְלַ֣עַת פְּקָעִ֔ים וּפְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים הַכֹּ֣ל אֶ֔רֶז אֵ֥ין אֶ֖בֶן נִרְאָֽה

verses.restored: He prepared inner sanctuary within house to set there ark of covenant of YHWH.

familiar.text: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

modern.text: Solomon also prepared the inner sanctuary within the temple to set the ark of the covenant of the LORD there.

original.text: וּדְבִ֧יר בְּתוֹךְ הַבַּ֛יִת מִפְּנִ֖ימָה הֵכִ֑ין לְתִתֵּ֣ן שָׁ֔ם אֶת אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֥ית יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty wide, and twenty high. He overlaid it with pure gold and overlaid cedar altar.

familiar.text: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.

modern.text: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold, and he also overlaid the altar of cedar.

original.text: וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֡יר עֶשְׂרִים֩ אַמָּ֨ה אֹ֜רֶךְ וְעֶשְׂרִ֧ים אַמָּ֣ה רֹ֗חַב וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔וֹ וַיְצַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וַיְצַ֥ף מִזְבֵּ֖חַ אָֽרֶז

verses.restored: Solomon overlaid house within with pure gold and drew chains of gold across before inner sanctuary; he overlaid it with gold.

familiar.text: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

modern.text: So Solomon overlaid the inside of the temple with pure gold, and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, which was overlaid with gold.

original.text: וַיְצַ֨ף שְׁלֹמֹ֧ה אֶת הַבַּ֛יִת מִפְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וַיְעַבֵּ֞ר ברתיקות זָהָב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֔יר וַיְצַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָֽב

verses.restored: All house he overlaid with gold until all house was completed; also all altar by inner sanctuary he overlaid with gold.

familiar.text: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.

modern.text: So he overlaid with gold the whole interior of the temple, until everything was completely finished. He also overlaid with gold the entire altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary. The Cherubim (2 Chronicles 3:10–13)

original.text: וְאֶת כָּל הַבַּ֛יִת צִפָּ֥ה זָהָ֖ב עַד תֹּ֣ם כָּל הַבָּ֑יִת וְכָל הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ אֲֽשֶׁר לַדְּבִ֖יר צִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב

verses.restored: Within inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olivewood, each ten cubits high.

familiar.text: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.

modern.text: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim, each ten cubits high, out of olive wood.

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בַּדְּבִ֔יר שְׁנֵ֥י כְרוּבִ֖ים עֲצֵי שָׁ֑מֶן עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: One wing of cherub was five cubits and other wing five; ten cubits from tip of one wing to tip of other.

familiar.text: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.

modern.text: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long, and the other wing was five cubits long as well. So the full wingspan was ten cubits.

original.text: וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת כְּנַ֤ף הַכְּרוּב֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת כְּנַ֥ף הַכְּר֖וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֔וֹת מִקְצ֥וֹת כְּנָפָ֖יו וְעַד קְצ֥וֹת כְּנָפָֽיו

verses.restored: Second cherub was ten cubits; both cherubim had one measure and one form.

familiar.text: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.

modern.text: The second cherub also measured ten cubits; both cherubim had the same size and shape,

original.text: וְעֶ֨שֶׂר֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה הַכְּר֖וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֑י מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וְקֶ֥צֶב אֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים

verses.restored: Height of one cherub was ten cubits, and so of second.

familiar.text: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.

modern.text: and the height of each cherub was ten cubits.

original.text: קוֹמַת֙ הַכְּר֣וּב הָֽאֶחָ֔ד עֶ֖שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן הַכְּר֥וּב הַשֵּׁנִֽי

verses.restored: He placed cherubim within inner house. Wings stretched out: wing of one touched one wall, wing of other touched other wall, and their wings touched each other in middle of house.

familiar.text: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

modern.text: And he placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple. Since their wings were spread out, the wing of the first cherub touched one wall, while the wing of the second cherub touched the other wall, and in the middle of the room their wingtips touched.

original.text: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֶת הַכְּרוּבִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ הַבַּ֣יִת הַפְּנִימִ֗י וַֽיִּפְרְשׂוּ֮ אֶת כַּנְפֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִים֒ וַתִּגַּ֤ע כְּנַף הָֽאֶחָד֙ בַּקִּ֔יר וּכְנַף֙ הַכְּר֣וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֔י נֹגַ֖עַת בַּקִּ֣יר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ הַבַּ֔יִת נֹגְעֹ֖ת כָּנָ֥ף אֶל כָּנָֽף

verses.restored: He overlaid cherubim with gold.

familiar.text: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.

modern.text: He also overlaid the cherubim with gold.

original.text: וַיְצַ֥ף אֶת הַכְּרוּבִ֖ים זָהָֽב

verses.restored: Upon all walls of house around he carved figures of cherubim, palms, and open flowers, inside and outside.

familiar.text: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.

modern.text: Then he carved the walls all around the temple, in both the inner and outer sanctuaries, with carved engravings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers.

original.text: וְאֵת֩ כָּל קִיר֨וֹת הַבַּ֜יִת מֵסַ֣ב קָלַ֗ע פִּתּוּחֵי֙ מִקְלְעוֹת֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְתִֽמֹרֹ֔ת וּפְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים מִלִּפְנִ֖ים וְלַחִיצֽוֹן

verses.restored: Floor of house he overlaid with gold, inside and outside.

familiar.text: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

modern.text: And he overlaid the temple floor with gold in both the inner and outer sanctuaries. The Doors

original.text: וְאֶת קַרְקַ֥ע הַבַּ֖יִת צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב לִפְנִ֖ימָה וְלַחִיצֽוֹן

verses.restored: For entrance of inner sanctuary he made doors of olivewood; lintel and doorposts formed a fifth part.

familiar.text: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.

modern.text: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary, Solomon constructed doors of olive wood with five-sided doorposts.

original.text: וְאֵת֙ פֶּ֣תַח הַדְּבִ֔יר עָשָׂ֖ה דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי שָׁ֑מֶן הָאַ֥יִל מְזוּז֖וֹת חֲמִשִֽׁית

verses.restored: On two olivewood doors he carved cherubim, palms, and open flowers, overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon cherubim and palms.

familiar.text: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.

modern.text: The double doors were made of olive wood, and he carved into them cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers and overlaid the cherubim and palm trees with hammered gold.

original.text: וּשְׁתֵּי֮ דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי שֶׁמֶן֒ וְקָלַ֣ע עֲ֠לֵיהֶם מִקְלְע֨וֹת כְּרוּבִ֧ים וְתִמֹר֛וֹת וּפְטוּרֵ֥י צִצִּ֖ים וְצִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב וַיָּ֛רֶד עַל הַכְּרוּבִ֥ים וְעַל הַתִּֽמֹר֖וֹת אֶת הַזָּהָֽב

verses.restored: Thus he made for entrance of temple doorposts of olivewood, a fourth part.

familiar.text: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.

modern.text: In the same way he made four-sided doorposts of olive wood for the sanctuary entrance.

original.text: וְכֵ֥ן עָשָׂ֛ה לְפֶ֥תַח הַֽהֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּז֣וֹת עֲצֵי שָׁ֑מֶן מֵאֵ֖ת רְבִעִֽית

verses.restored: Two doors were cypress; two leaves of one door folded, and two leaves of other folded.

familiar.text: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

modern.text: The two doors were made of cypress wood, and each had two folding panels.

original.text: וּשְׁתֵּ֥י דַלְת֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י צְלָעִ֜ים הַדֶּ֤לֶת הָֽאַחַת֙ גְּלִילִ֔ים וּשְׁנֵ֧י קְלָעִ֛ים הַדֶּ֥לֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית גְּלִילִֽים

verses.restored: He carved cherubim, palms, and open flowers and overlaid them with gold fitted upon carving.

familiar.text: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.

modern.text: He carved into them cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold, hammered evenly over the carvings. The Courtyard

original.text: וְקָלַ֤ע כְּרוּבִים֙ וְתִ֣מֹר֔וֹת וּפְטֻרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים וְצִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֔ב מְיֻשָּׁ֖ר עַל הַמְּחֻקֶּֽה

verses.restored: He built inner court with three rows of hewn stone and one row of cedar beams.

familiar.text: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

modern.text: Solomon built the inner courtyard with three rows of dressed stone and one row of trimmed cedar beams.

original.text: וַיִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔ית שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה טוּרֵ֣י גָזִ֑ית וְט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֥ת אֲרָזִֽים

verses.restored: In fourth year foundation of house of YHWH was laid, in month Ziv.

familiar.text: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:

modern.text: The foundation of the house of the LORD was laid in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign, in the month of Ziv.

original.text: בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔ית יֻסַּ֖ד בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּיֶ֖רַח זִֽו

verses.restored: In eleventh year, in month Bul, eighth month, house was finished in all its parts and according to all its plan. He built it seven years.

familiar.text: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

modern.text: In his eleventh year and eighth month, the month of Bul, the temple was finished in every detail and according to every specification. So he built the temple in seven years.

original.text: וּבַשָּׁנָה֩ הָאַחַ֨ת עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה בְּיֶ֣רַח בּ֗וּל ה֚וּא הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י כָּלָ֣ה הַבַּ֔יִת לְכָל דְּבָרָ֖יו וּלְכָל משפטו וַיִּבְנֵ֖הוּ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים

translation_notes: The 480-year chronology is a major historical and textual question and should not be presented as uncontested modern dating.
The building's silence is achieved by preparing stone elsewhere; it does not mean construction was effortless or quiet for quarry workers.
The central Divine word interrupts architectural detail to make presence conditional upon justice and covenant practice. The building itself cannot guarantee Divine residence.
Cedar, cypress, olivewood, stone, and gold connect worship to forests, mines, quarries, transport, craft knowledge, and ecological extraction.
The text attributes construction to Solomon while thousands of unnamed laborers, foreign specialists, artisans, planners, and carriers produced it.
Cherubim are ancient sacred throne/guardian imagery, not decorative proof for modern angel anatomy.
Gold saturation signals splendor and concentrated wealth. Sacred luxury should be read beside forced labor and palace extraction.
A temple can hold memory, prayer, and communal identity without containing or owning the Divine.
safety_note: Do not use the temple to sanctify exploitative construction, ecological destruction, wealth display, or claims that one institution possesses Divine presence. The chapter itself makes presence answer to faithful practice rather than architecture.
